caveats.clear_water: Clear-water modelling; sediment and debris are not represented.
caveats.moraine_extrapolation: Moraine-dam results extrapolate beyond the calibration data.
caveats.caveat_arrival_depth_not_joint: Arrival and depth percentiles are marginal estimates, not a joint distribution.
caveats.direct_solver_output: Direct D-Flow FM output; confidence is LOW and this result is not scientifically validated.
caveats.timeline_single_solver: Playback frames are selected snapshots from one real solver run; HIGH/POSSIBLE aliases are not uncertainty bands.
caveats.mvp_reconstructed_forcing: The South Lhonak forcing is an MVP reconstruction, not an observed hydrograph.
caveats.single_run_impact: Impact is calculated from one deterministic run. The POSSIBLE column is the run footprint, not an uncertainty probability.
caveats.impact_exposure_coverage: Exposure has limited or unrecorded coverage; missing asset classes are not assessed.
caveats.placeholder_data: Some impact inputs remain placeholders, so monetary loss is unavailable.
caveats.caveat_loss_national_average: JRC max-damage values are 2010 national averages for India; Himalayan stone or timber-built houses may cost quite differently to rebuild — loss is a rough estimate, not a precise valuation.
caveats.dem_depression_ponding: The maximum depth sits in an unconditioned DEM depression that traps water rather than a hydraulic peak; the source terrain was never hydrologically conditioned.
caveats.clear_water_steep_reach_velocity: The maximum velocity is clear-water Manning flow on a steep gorge reach; it is not necessarily representative of a debris-laden event.
caveats.poi_grid_snapping: One or more downstream points of interest show no inundation despite a wet cell nearby, most likely 90 m grid resolution missing the channel at that point rather than the location being unaffected.
caveats.comparison_unavailable: No paired solver comparison is available for this run.
caveats.no_observed_extent: No observed flood-extent outline has been digitized for this event; extent metrics (IoU/F1) are not available.
caveats.literature_comparison_only: Point values below are compared with other published model reconstructions, not with direct field observations.
caveats.emulator_not_validated: This emulator has no LOOCV validation report; its skill is unknown.
caveats.demo_mode: Demo-mode emulator: trained on a short demo library, confidence LOW.
caveats.outside_trained_range: Inputs are outside the emulator's training range; this is extrapolation.
caveats.scenario_emulator_probability: Scenario mode: zones use the emulator's own uncertainty for one scenario, not breach-parameter uncertainty.
caveats.query_placeholders: The flood query used placeholder site inputs; impact numbers inherit that.
caveats.loss_placeholder: Monetary loss is unavailable because a conversion factor is still a placeholder.
caveats.pilot_run_not_production_accepted: Pilot run: registered for demonstration with its acceptance result recorded; not a production-accepted result.
caveats.production_gate_blocked: Production gate BLOCKED: required site inputs are placeholders or missing.

onboarding.demoDetail: Open the registered South Lhonak 2023 D-Flow FM result. Reconstructed forcing and pilot-domain caveats remain visible in the result.
onboarding.validationEmptyDetail: A single real solver run is not a validation dataset. No M5 LOOCV or observed-event comparison is registered for this site.

onboarding.validationLoocvNone: No emulator LOOCV report is registered for this site.

onboarding.validationHistoricalError: Historical-event comparison could not be loaded.
onboarding.validationNoEvent: This site has no declared historical event to compare against.
onboarding.validationLiteratureNone: This run has no comparable point-of-interest output yet.
onboarding.noPairedSph: Only one model run is available for this scenario. A SPH / Delft3D comparison needs both runs to finish, post-process and pass the SPH particle-retention check; no comparison metrics are shown until then.
onboarding.libraryUnavailable: No real scenario library is registered. The Teesta MVP contains one direct solver event run, not prepared emulator nodes.
onboarding.placeholderNotice: Everything you enter is saved as an unverified placeholder unless you give a source. Blank fields stay empty placeholders; nothing is filled in for you.
onboarding.locationHelp: The dam location must fall inside the study-area bounds. The site ID is derived from the site name and must be unique.
onboarding.terrainHelp: TerraFlow downloads the terrain itself once the site is registered: Copernicus GLO-30 and SRTM elevation (OpenTopography; the server needs OPENTOPOGRAPHY_API_KEY), ESA WorldCover land cover, a HydroBASINS catchment when available and GloFAS river discharge. The onboarding job compares the elevation models, picks one, and shows every step and any error in its log.
onboarding.breachHelp: Breach inputs for the empirical breach equations. Leave any value you do not know blank; it is recorded as a placeholder.
onboarding.submitHelp: This registers the site, saves its configuration, and queues a real onboarding job. The next step shows that job's actual stage and any error.
onboarding.noJob: No onboarding job has been started yet. Register the site in the previous step.
onboarding.terrainMissing: Still empty (the onboarding job will stop with terrain_inputs_incomplete):
